12/➲ $SHIB

➺ $SHIB (Shiba Inu) is one of the most well-known meme coins. With its origins rooted in being a “Dogecoin killer,” it now boasts a large ecosystem, including ShibaSwap, and has gained major attention in the crypto world.

7/➲ $BONK

➺ Originally launched on the Solana network, $BONK is a meme token with fast transaction times and low fees. It's built for community engagement and aims to become Solana’s answer to Dogecoin.

1/➲ @BabyDogeCoin 

➺ A spinoff of Dogecoin, $BabyDoge is known for its hyper-deflationary nature. It aims to reward holders by adding tokens to their wallets with each transaction and focuses on charity and animal welfare.
